plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Political Science, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/political-science-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Political Science Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 4 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', 5 = 'See program recommendations or requirements', 6 = 'See approved Foreign Language list for the AA Degree' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. The semester-4 footnote-5 slot is published as 3-4 units and is modeled at 4 units to match the catalog's published semester total of 13. Part of a 2+2 program: graduates are eligible for transfer to upper-division status in UNR's College of Liberal Arts. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
